notes:
Workspace and input controls

• Copy selected terminal text with Ctrl+C without interrupting the session.
• Reorder hosts, expand their workspaces with one click and fit more rows in the sidebar.
• Group terminals into tabs and clone persistent terminal views into hostless workspaces.
• Discover voice shortcuts on first Listen and double-tap the toggle hotkey to submit reviewed dictation.
• Read desktop and mobile release history together.
• Explain unsupported Windows Tailscale SSH targets and distinguish unknown host keys from changed keys.

Workspaces and navigation

• Use the DazeDev home layout with host sections, workspace menus and credits at the bottom.
• Drag workspace handles to reorder the host profile.
• Group terminals as tabs and collect existing terminal views in hostless workspaces on the phone.
• Read the global changelog with platform filters.
• Check the public GitHub repository for Android APK updates; offline development installs remain available.
• Keep the first-tap listening and Enter-to-close voice flow.

Voice input

• Tap Voice to open a blank prompt and start listening.
• Tap End to stop and edit, or Enter to submit once and return to the terminal.
• Keep the draft when delivery fails or the terminal changes.

Updates

• Download signed Windows updates from GitHub Releases over HTTPS.
• Use configured HTTP proxies when checking and downloading updates.

Fixes

• Keep unchanged runtime files in place during updates so files still in use do not block installation.
• Check changed files for locks before replacing the app and retry short Windows file locks.
• Identify the blocked file if installation cannot continue.

Major features

• Search live terminals in the current terminal, workspace, host or all hosts. Browse scrollable results, then use Enter and Shift+Enter to move between matches across workspaces with a compact search bar. Search uses current terminal buffers without saving content or query history.

Improvements

• Shift-click terminal headers to select a group, then drop it onto a workspace to move the terminals immediately into a vertical stack on the right.
• Drag workspaces to reorder them within a host in the sidebar.
• Show terminal and tmux names in a large, bold single line at the top left, with the session type beside them.
• Keep repository and tmux controls visible as terminal headers narrow, then reduce them to tmux and the menu, and finally the menu alone.

Improvements

• Begin the Alpha-V0.3 release series. Incremental updates use 0.3.01, 0.3.02 and onward.

Bug fixes

• Restore image and file link clicks after closing a preview, including repeated clicks on the same terminal cell in main and detached windows.
• Close stale PowerShell terminals and workspaces when their session has already ended, without getting stuck in the End sessions prompt.

Improvements

• Open relative image, HTML, Markdown and source file paths from terminal output in the built-in viewer.
• Rename the sidebar Feedback / Donate button to Feedback / Support.

Bug fixes

• Open complete URLs across wrapped terminal rows, including Windows screen snapshots and filenames split at a hyphen. Retain the continuation and query string.
• Click an image to open its in-app viewer. Ctrl+click an image URL to open it in your browser (Cmd+click on macOS).

Improvements

• Open Settings from the bottom-left sidebar. Reduce spacing between its bottom actions.

Bug fixes

• Open complete URLs across soft-wrapped terminal lines, including long links. Recover hostnames broken at a hyphen near the edge by terminal output formatting.

Improvements

• Send feedback through the public HTTPS relay. Remember contact details and retain messages when delivery cannot be confirmed.
• Bundle shared donation links, artwork and feedback copy locally; no remote code is loaded.

Improvements

• Show the publication date before each version in the changelog. Historical dates use the recorded release dates.

Major features

• View images inside DazeDev with wheel zoom, drag to pan and double-click to fit.
• Ctrl-click (Cmd-click on macOS) supported image, HTML, Markdown and source file paths in terminal output to open them on the terminal’s host. HTML and Markdown open in preview mode; other text files open as source.
• Find Feedback, updates, Discord and donation options together in the sidebar Feedback / Donate popup. GitHub Sponsors, Buy Me a Coffee and PayPal are enabled with branded buttons and checkout notes.

Improvements

• Refine popup spacing and version status. Turn off the sidebar glow with the checkbox in the popup.
• Explain broadcast prompts with examples for returning to long-running sessions and wrapping up work.

Notes

HTML previews block scripts and external assets. Local file paths must be absolute or start with ~/; quote paths with spaces or use Markdown links. Soft voice cues remain parked.

Major features

• Open Donate and about from the sidebar version area, with app version, update controls, feedback guidance and project links.
• Support DazeDev through the PayPal donation page. Buy Me a Coffee and GitHub Sponsors are marked Coming soon.

Bug fixes

• Show PowerShell close choices in a two-by-two layout with wrapping labels, keeping End sessions visible.
• Use PowerShell session labels in Sessions and Install agents on local Windows hosts.

Major features

• Add a Local Windows PowerShell host with persistent sessions. Close DazeDev and reconnect to the same running shell, variables and work. Choose End sessions, Keep in background or Continue in PowerShell window when closing. PowerShell 7 is available when already installed.
• Add Connect all hosts above New host.

Bug fixes

• Keep terminal colours on detached windows and update them when workspace colours change.
• Put Close at the bottom of terminal context menus.
• Keep collapsed terminal menu text readable with light workspace colours.

Notes

Native PowerShell persistence is Windows-only. Physical multi-monitor movement, desktop focus and visible external-console interaction have not been verified on the remote test desktop. Soft voice cues remain parked.

Major features

• Move terminals into separate windows on other screens. They stay in their workspace and remain open when switching workspaces; selecting a workspace raises its windows.
• Connect several hosts without blocking the workspace. Recover saved mixed-host workspaces with Connect or Keep disconnected.
• Click secondary-host labels to connect or disconnect that host and its terminals.
• Paste clipboard text, images and files with Ctrl+V or Ctrl+Shift+V.
• Open Markdown and rules from the host menu; collapsed terminal controls now read Menu.

Bug fixes

• Return focus to the terminal after pasting a repository prompt, so Enter submits it instead of reopening Repo.
• Keep the same terminal session when detaching or docking its window. Retain output when explicitly disconnected.

Windows build, update tests and native interface checks passed. Physical multi-monitor dragging, visible overlap order and voice-device behavior still need confirmation on an interactive desktop.

Major features

• Compact Settings into expandable sections, with PIN setup shown only when needed.
• Read concise feature and bug-fix lists throughout the changelog history.

Bug fixes

• Keep browser-link clicks on the desktop instead of also sending them to remote agents.
• Let image uploads finish while the terminal prints output.
• Match Split and Move/duplicate to the other terminal menu items.
• Keep the dictionary action available and preserve selected text when opening it.

Use Ctrl+Shift+V or Paste for clipboard images. Ordinary Ctrl+V handling is unchanged.

Major features

• Keep the last terminal text visible and copyable while disconnected. A muted-red, single-line banner offers reconnection and shortens in narrow panes.
• Read release notes as separate feature and bug-fix lists.

Bug fixes

• Keep reconnect attempts from clearing the retained display; restore live input only when the terminal is ready.
• Reduce the recording tail from 750 ms to 250 ms to test whether it reduces invented trailing words.

The recording change is experimental; it does not establish that transcription hallucinations are fixed.

Major features

• Dock multiple Monaco viewers beside terminals. Move, resize and arrange them without losing edits; preview Markdown and static HTML.
• Open links in your desktop browser with Ctrl-click (Cmd-click on macOS). New remote shells and agents can use the same browser.
• Use separate voice hotkeys for terminal dictation and IDE commands. Review commands and broadcasts before sending them.
• Save a personal phrase dictionary, with backups, import/export and optional sync through your own SSH host.
• Set host and terminal colours, use square-first Balance layouts and adjust supported tmux settings.
• Paste screenshots and files up to 10 MiB to upload them and insert their paths without pressing Enter. Uploads check available space.
• Add an optional startup PIN, off by default.
• Find update status in the sidebar and at the top of Settings, with automatic checks every 30 minutes.
• Use the Split-first terminal menu and drag commands into your preferred order. Find third-party licences in Settings.

Bug fixes

• Restore reconnect controls and recover interrupted host and terminal connections.
• Keep voice input in the open command or broadcast dialog. Enter finishes recording, Escape cancels, and a 750 ms audio tail helps retain the last word.
• Correct S1-mini cleanup controls.
• Keep cross-host highlighting on the host label and collapse narrow terminal controls into a menu.
• Set a Windows taskbar identity to prevent incorrect app grouping.
• Return browser-launch errors without blocking the app or leaving hidden Windows error dialogs.

Notes

Restart existing remote agents to inherit browser forwarding. Remote localhost/OAuth forwarding is not included. HTML previews block scripts and external assets. Native PowerShell persistence, multi-monitor detachment and microphone forwarding remain deferred.

Major features

• Move terminals between workspaces; Ctrl-drag adds another view of the same tmux session. Connections stay on their original hosts.
• Duplicate plain terminals into fresh shells, keeping the working directory where detectable.
• Hover over a workspace to switch and choose a docking position. Escape or an invalid drop cancels.
• Group GitHub repositories by owner, separate local repositories, and list worktrees with modification dates.
• Open the agent’s live model/effort picker from the bottom right.

Bug fixes

• Reduce and balance terminal padding; restore the standard Host button.
• Collapse repeated repository scan messages.
• Show the changelog once after each update.

Major features

• Check published GitHub releases on Windows. Public releases need no GitHub login; downloads still require confirmation.

Bug fixes

• Move dictation recovery copies into the terminal title-bar menu. Remove repeated banners that resized the workspace.

Major features

• Add portable macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel and Linux x64 test builds with native offline voice runtimes. Updates on these platforms are manual.

Bug fixes

• Stop the host/workspace menu covering the app when its dismiss layer is hovered.

Major features

• Highlight retained dictation with the selected border effect.
• Review the full transcription in a scrollable window before copying or discarding it. Closing the window retains the text; review and copy never submit it.

Bug fixes

• Include the Windows SSH startup fix from alpha14.

Bug fixes

• Fix Windows SSH and Tailscale SSH failures reporting “The filename or extension is too long.” Send the host helper after authentication to stay within Windows command limits.

Major features

• Add per-host clipboard permissions, screen-reader output, diagnostics and SSH Include aliases.
• Allow model downloads to be cancelled and check available disk space.
• Warn before closing plain terminals or sharing working copies; retain local profile recovery.
• Animate highlights independently of Windows settings by default.

Bug fixes

• Keep dictation tied to its original terminal and foreground program. Retain uncertain deliveries for review or copy.
• Recover interrupted microphones and damaged settings.
• Keep host controls responsive during discovery and ignore stale connection events.
• Release GPU renderers for hidden terminals.
• Keep highlight particle density proportional and prevent terminal glow from being clipped.

Bug fixes

• Reconnect hosts after sleep or network loss, with controls for failed panes.
• Keep terminal writes off the UI thread and limit waits for stalled input or host probes.
• Retry detached terminals without restarting the app or replaying commands.
• Preserve tmux sessions and healthy terminals when host management reconnects.

Major features

• Start maximized.
• Compact Settings into one model download/selection list, followed by voice hotkeys and behaviour.
• Show transcription, model loading, S1-mini cleanup and paste progress.
• Use 60 slower highlight particles with drifting smoke and varied brightness.
• Speed up cleanup with verified speculative decoding.

Bug fixes

• Return to usable shells after agent, tmux or shell exit.
• Repair retained dead panes in DazeDev-created sessions.

Major features

• Detect hardware, recommend a voice model and report Vulkan availability.
• Centre voice status and slightly blur the rest of the app during dictation.
• Start fullscreen; use F11 to toggle fullscreen.

Bug fixes

• Buffer audio within a RAM limit, batch speech when behind and adapt previews to inference speed.
• Reduce resource contention with binary audio transfer, bounded inference threads and cleanup after recording.
• Unload voice models when settings change.
• Move energy and rainbow animations to the compositor.
• Validate tmux names at the first Next step.

Major features

• Show voice status in a softly pulsing box in the secondary terminal bar.
• Show only an alert while preparing. During listening, fade in the border, dim the app and lift the receiving pane; restore the view when listening stops.
• Use 30 blue-energy particles at a quarter of their previous speed, with drifting paths, wispy tails and varied sparkle.

Major features

• Add per-device choices to follow system motion settings, always animate highlights or keep them still.
• Explain when reduced motion stops an effect. The override applies only to terminal, workspace and preview highlights.

Major features

• Add blue particle trails and pulsing rainbow borders; use the selected effect on the active workspace.
• Make the sidebar resizable, wrap names and enlarge New workspace buttons.
• Apply themes to the app shell while retaining terminal backgrounds.
• Move notifications into the title bar.
• Remove terminal Agent buttons and rename the sidebar action Install agents.

Major features

• Add compact workspace controls, theme cycling and workspace/terminal colours.
• Show Listen indicators, live transcription and download progress; add hold-to-talk.
• Add terminal links, search, clipboard, GPU rendering, images, ligatures, output export and flow control.
• Install agents visibly in tmux; add native model/effort pickers and per-host repository prompt templates.
• Offer Blue energy, Rainbow shimmer and Static colour recording borders.

Bug fixes

• Keep terminal input working when host management disconnects.
• Reveal and retain the dictation destination through recording, cleanup and paste.

Major features

• Add a minimal home screen and shared branding.
• Add instant splits, drag docking with edge previews, adaptive tiling and column layouts.
• Add direct dictation and configurable Windows keyboard, mouse and media hotkeys.

Bug fixes

• Preserve terminal processes when arranging or maximizing panes; return to a shell after tmux detach.
• Keep dialogs open during text-selection drags.

Major features

• Create workspaces with a name, host and terminal count.
• Open plain shells without launching an agent or creating a tmux session.
• Join an existing session or create a named session with an optional agent, repository and orientation.
• Warn about unsaved work before deleting a session.

Major features

• Add specific connection prompts and host-trust buttons.
• Explain voice model choices, discover named microphones and show voice readiness.
• Add Blue, Charcoal and Green themes, empty-state host actions and the changelog.

Bug fixes

• Fix Windows connection-terminal startup and authentication submission.
• Restore one-click voice setup.

Major features

• Rename the app to DazeDev.
• Keep client data portable and migrate legacy data.
• Add host deletion, first-run voice setup, signed update checks and the portable updater.

Major features

• Add a collapsible host/workspace sidebar, workspace deletion and Tailscale SSH connections.

Major features

• Introduce terminal workspaces, local/SSH tmux management, agent discovery and offline voice processing.
